_doc: PRE-REGISTERED spec for G11-LEVEL-MEMORY-AB-REPLAY (automation/overnight/queue.md, 2026-07-09 after-hours item). The G11 level-memory wire shipped LIVE 2026-07-09 07:02 MT (~09:02 ET) -- setup/scripts/refresh_levels_intraday.py#_merge_memory_levels unions the shadow multi-day memory map (automation/state/key-levels-memory.json, produced by level_memory_producer.py) into the live key-levels.json feed every 5-min refresh cycle, GATED ONLY by params.json 'level_memory_live_merge' (currently true, Safe account only). It shipped as an engine-benefit wire but NO A/B scorecard was ever run before/after. This freezes the scoring spec BEFORE any run.
status: RETIRED_UNRUNNABLE_AS_FROZEN -- not a verdict on the hypothesis
build_step_complete: backtest/lib/levels.py#_detect_from_history extended with an ADDITIVE-ONLY 'memory_levels_by_day' kwarg (default None = zero behavior change for every existing caller) that mirrors refresh_levels_intraday.py#_merge_memory_levels' spot-band+cap selection EXACTLY (nearest memory_cap=6 within memory_spot_pct=0.015 of the day's compute-time spot, unioned into BOTH LevelSet.active and LevelSet.multi_day -- memory levels always carry a directional role, matching heartbeat_core._read_levels' multi_day promotion, which matters because multi_day_levels feeds detect_confluence). Smoke-verified: baseline call with memory_levels_by_day=None is byte-identical to the pre-change call; a synthetic in-band candidate is added, an out-of-band candidate is correctly excluded. OPRA option cache backfilled for the 4 missing trading days (2026-07-09/07-10/07-13/07-14, 88 contracts, ATM+/-5 strikes, 0 errors) via backtest/tools/expand_opra_cache.py so `use_real_fills=True` covers the full scoring window without BS-fallback gaps. Master SPY file extended to backtest/data/spy_5m_2025-01-01_2026-07-14.csv (concat of the 2025-01-01_2026-07-08 master + the fresh 2026-05-19_2026-07-14 window, deduped/sorted) solely so expand_opra_cache.py's strike-centering resolved real closes for the new dates -- the actual backtest run uses the matched spy_5m_2026-05-19_2026-07-14.csv / vix_5m_2026-05-19_2026-07-14.csv pair.
hypothesis: The memory-merge wire changes engine behavior (adds new ENTER triggers via memory-sourced level_reclaim/level_rejection, or promotes an existing trigger to CONFLUENCE via a nearby multi-day memory level) on a non-trivial number of sessions, and the net real-fills P&L on the CHANGED cohort (participation-added + shared-trade behavior-change trades) is NEGATIVE -- i.e. the wire is actively hurting the live Safe account, not merely inert.
mechanism_disclosure: The backtest engine's OWN level detection (backtest/lib/levels.py#_detect_from_history) has ZERO notion of level_memory as of this freeze -- confirmed by code read, it derives levels purely from OHLC price structure (prior-day H/L/C, POC, 5-day rolling H/L, VWAP anchors, round numbers). The live wire only touches the LIVE feed (refresh_levels_intraday.py -> key-levels.json), which the backtest never reads. Therefore CONTROL (the vanilla backtest, unmodified) is the correct proxy for 'wire OFF' / current backtest-modeled behavior, and TREATMENT (backtest + the new memory_levels_by_day injection, computed via the SAME formula as the live merge) is the correct proxy for 'wire ON'. This IS the counterfactual simulation the queue item asked for, built on REAL production trigger logic (backtest/lib/filters.py's detect_level_reclaim/detect_level_rejection/detect_confluence, unmodified) rather than a reimplementation.

P1_counterfactual_replay.label: MODELED (real trigger logic, real OPRA fills)
P1_counterfactual_replay.source: run_backtest() (backtest/lib/orchestrator.py) called twice over the SAME historical window with the SAME live Safe params.json overrides (via _params_to_kwargs, initial_equity=1746.75 -> ATM strike tier per v15_strike_offset_per_tier) and use_real_fills=True: CONTROL = unmodified; TREATMENT = level_flags={'memory_levels_by_day': <precomputed>, 'memory_spot_pct': 0.015, 'memory_cap': 6}.
P1_counterfactual_replay.memory_candidate_precompute: For each scoring-window trading day D, level_memory_producer.build_levels(history_through_prior_close(D)) -- causal, using ONLY bars strictly before D's first bar (no look-ahead), LOOKBACK_DAYS=10 trading days (production default). Filtered to tier=='Active' (equivalent to memory_score>=60, level_memory_producer's own STRONG_MEMORY threshold -- the SAME floor refresh_levels_intraday's MEMORY_MERGE_MIN_SCORE=60.0 uses). The spot-band (+/-1.5% of the day's compute-time close) + nearest-6 cap is applied INSIDE _detect_from_history at call time (spot = history['close'].iloc[-1] at first-bar-of-day, since the orchestrator caches LevelSet PER DAY -- see deviation_disclosure below).
P1_counterfactual_replay.window_lookback_buffer: 2026-05-19..2026-06-04 (~11 trading days) -- feeds the 10-trading-day LOOKBACK_DAYS window for every scored day without truncation. Not itself scored.
P1_counterfactual_replay.window_scored: 2026-06-05..2026-07-14 (all trading days spy_5m_2026-05-19_2026-07-14.csv covers in this range; expected ~27 sessions, exact count reported at run time -- weekends/holidays excluded naturally by the bar data).
P1_counterfactual_replay.sub_cohort_A_participation_only_wire_liv: 2026-07-09, 2026-07-10, 2026-07-14 -- the 3 REAL trading sessions since the wire actually went live (2026-07-09 09:02 ET; 07-11/07-12 weekend, 07-13 Sunday). Reported SEPARATELY as the honest 'what actually happened live' cohort, cross-checked against automation/state/core-decisions.jsonl (account=='safe') for that window: any row with an ENTER verdict whose trigger_level_exact matches (within $0.10) a memory-merged candidate price is flagged as a REAL live decision the wire touched.
P1_counterfactual_replay.sub_cohort_B_counterfactual_only: 2026-06-05..2026-07-08 -- pre-wire sessions, real wire was OFF; TREATMENT here is a pure simulation of 'what if it had been on'.

deviation_disclosure.frozen_at_open_spot: The orchestrator caches LevelSet PER TRADING DAY (backtest/lib/orchestrator.py's `_level_per_day` dict, frozen at the FIRST bar the day is encountered -- a pre-existing performance optimization, not something this study introduced). This means the spot used for the +/-1.5% memory-level band is the day's OPENING price (04:00 premarket bar if present, else 09:30), not a continuously-5-min-refreshed spot like the LIVE refresh_levels_intraday.py cycle uses intraday. This is a CONSERVATIVE simplification: it will tend to UNDERSTATE how often a memory level enters/exits the live band as spot drifts through the session, biasing toward fewer participation events, not more. Disclosed, not corrected mid-study (no_repick_clause).
deviation_disclosure.no_intraday_recompute: The live wire's memory candidate SET itself (before the spot-band filter) is also computed once per day here (via prior-close history), whereas production's level_memory_producer.py can in principle run on a schedule intraday too. Multi-day memory levels are, by construction, DERIVED FROM MULTI-DAY structure and do not meaningfully change within a single session, so this is not expected to matter -- disclosed for completeness.

primary_metric.trade_diff: TradeFill records from CONTROL and TREATMENT matched by (entry_time_et, side). THREE buckets: (a) treatment_only = new entries enabled by the wire (participation), (b) control_only = entries REMOVED by the wire (would violate the wire's own 'purely additive' design intent if non-zero -- e.g. a memory-enabled earlier trade consuming the day's quality-lock/one-trade slot and preempting a later control-only trade; reported as a DISTINCT finding, not folded into (a)), (c) shared = same (entry_time_et, side) present in both, diffed on rejection_level/triggers_fired/quality_tier for a same-bar behavior change (e.g. promotion to CONFLUENCE via a newly-added multi_day level) even when the trade itself is unchanged.
primary_metric.pnl_delta: sum(treatment dollar_pnl) - sum(control dollar_pnl) on real-OPRA-fills, decomposed per bucket: participation-added P&L (bucket a), removed-trade P&L (bucket b, signed as a LOSS to treatment since those trades no longer fire), and shared-trade P&L delta (bucket c, expected ~0 unless entry mechanics genuinely differ).

nulls_and_evidence_floor.n_honesty: This mechanism is narrow by construction (score>=60 AND within 1.5% of spot AND capped at 6 nearest, layered on top of an already-selective trigger/gate stack) -- a LOW or ZERO participation count over the scoring window is an EXPECTED, publishable outcome, not a study failure. No shuffle-null is pre-registered given the expected small n; if bucket (a)+(c) combined n >= 15, an empirical sign-test (binomial, p=0.5) on per-trade win/loss will be reported as an ADVISORY secondary statistic only -- never a standalone pass/fail gate at this n.
nulls_and_evidence_floor.concentration_disclosure: top-1 and top-3 trade share of the total P&L delta, reported regardless of verdict (OP-20).

kill_criteria_and_confidence_bar.statement: Per the queue item's own pre-authorized revert clause ('revert = flip level_memory_live_merge:false if negative'):
kill_criteria_and_confidence_bar.condition_negative: NEGATIVE = the combined participation + shared-behavior-change P&L delta (buckets a+c, with bucket b reported alongside but not required to be zero) is < $0 AND the finding is not degenerate (at least 1 real trade in bucket a or c -- an all-zero-participation window cannot be 'negative', it is NO_EFFECT). NEGATIVE -> recommend flipping level_memory_live_merge to false, ship the revert (after-hours, pre-authorized), add a one-line revert-of-the-revert note + guard.
kill_criteria_and_confidence_bar.condition_no_effect: ZERO trades in bucket a AND zero behavior-changes in bucket c over the full scoring window (06-05..07-14, 27 sessions) -> NO_EFFECT. The flag stays ON (an inert wire is not the same as a harmful one, and the queue item's revert clause is conditioned on 'if negative') but is flagged for the standing instrument note that memory-merge participation has not yet been observed to fire.
kill_criteria_and_confidence_bar.condition_positive_or_insufficient_n: Non-zero participation with a POSITIVE combined P&L delta, OR non-zero participation with n < 15 (evidence floor, OP-16 advisory) regardless of sign -> flag stays ON, verdict labeled POSITIVE or INSUFFICIENT_N respectively (never silently treated as a pass at low n).
kill_criteria_and_confidence_bar.live_cross_check: sub_cohort_A (the 3 real wire-live sessions) is reported as its own line regardless of the P1 counterfactual verdict -- if ZERO real core-decisions.jsonl ENTER rows on those 3 days show a trigger_level_exact matching a memory candidate, that is independently reported (the wire has not yet touched a single real live decision in its first 3 sessions of operation).

no_repick_clause: Once frozen (this commit), the scoring window (06-05..07-14), lookback buffer (05-19..06-04), memory_spot_pct (0.015), memory_cap (6), memory_score floor (60, tier=='Active'), matching key ((entry_time_et, side)), use_real_fills=True, and initial_equity (1746.75, current live Safe equity) may not be edited in light of results. A NO_EFFECT or NEGATIVE verdict is a publishable, informative outcome -- not a reason to adjust and re-run. Any genuine build-time correction discovered AFTER this freeze gets fixed via a NEW pre-reg version bump with the correction disclosed, never a silent edit to this frozen spec.
